name: MarqueeAll – Elementor Marquee Widgets: Image, Text, Post Grid, Testimonial & News Ticker 🌀
author: Aman Brar

sections.description:
MarqueeAll – Elementor Addon – Carousel, Ticker & Infinite Scroller Widgets lets you easily create smooth, continuous scrolling content on your Elementor pages.

Showcase images, text, testimonials, news, or posts in a highly interactive marquee, with full control over speed, direction, spacing, and hover behavior. Perfect for portfolios, blogs, agencies, e-commerce, and corporate websites.

Widgets Included

📌 Post Grid Marquee (New in 1.1.1)
Show your blog posts or custom posts in a scrolling grid layout. Supports featured images, author, date, excerpts, read more links, horizontal/vertical scrolling, reverse direction, pause-on-hover, and adjustable speed & gap. Perfect for news sites, portfolios, and blogs looking for dynamic post presentation.

🖼️ Image Marquee
Showcase images with smooth scrolling, optional lightbox, custom links, and lazy loading. Control speed, gap, and direction easily.

📝 Text Marquee
Scroll text content with icons, adjustable typography, and horizontal/vertical directions. Perfect for announcements or promotional text.

💬 Testimonial Marquee
Highlight customer reviews with names, avatars, ratings, and text in a continuous scroll. Supports horizontal and vertical layouts.

📰 News Ticker
Display latest posts or news items in a smooth ticker. Supports labels, icons, separators, reverse scrolling, and hover pause.

Feature Highlights

  • Smooth, infinite scrolling marquee
  • Supports Image, Text, Testimonial, News Ticker, and Post Grid
  • Horizontal & vertical scrolling directions
  • Reverse scrolling & pause-on-hover functionality
  • Adjustable speed, spacing (gap), and item size
  • Soft edge gradient mask for elegant look
  • Lightbox support, lazy loading, and custom links for images
  • Fully responsive and lightweight CSS/JS
  • Elementor-native controls for easy customization

SEO & Performance Highlights

  • Minimal CSS/JS for fast loading
  • Fully responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop
  • Helps improve user engagement by highlighting content dynamically
  • Supports structured content for images, text, testimonials, news, and posts
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/marqueeall directory, or install via WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Elementor editor and search for “Marquee” widgets.
  4. Drag, drop, and customize each widget to your needs.
sections.faq:
Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any theme that is compatible with Elementor.

Can I control the scrolling speed and direction?

Yes, you can adjust speed, direction (left, right, up, down), and spacing (gap) for every marquee widget.

How many items should I add for best performance?

For a smooth and seamless experience, we recommend 8–10 items per marquee. Adding too few items may break the continuous scrolling effect.

Can I add links or lightbox to images?

Yes, the Image Marquee supports custom links, media file lightbox, or no link as per your preference.

Does the plugin support lazy loading?

Yes, you can enable lazy loading to improve page speed and performance.

Can I pause the marquee on hover?

Absolutely! Each widget has a pause-on-hover option to allow users to read content easily.

screenshots.caption: MarqueeAll widgets – Example of Text, Image, Testimonials, News Ticker, and Post Grid marquees in action inside Elementor page builder.
Text Marquee widget – Smooth scrolling text with options to control direction (left, right, up, down), speed, and looping behavior.
Image Marquee widget – Create continuous scrolling image carousels with customizable direction, spacing, and animation settings.
Testimonials Marquee widget – Showcase client testimonials in an infinite marquee with adjustable scroll direction, transition effects, and autoplay controls.
News Ticker Marquee widget – Display latest news or updates in a ticker-style marquee with settings for scroll direction, delay, and pause on hover.

Post Grid Marquee widget – Display posts in a scrolling grid with featured image, author, date, excerpt, and read more link. Supports horizontal/vertical scrolling, reverse, pause-on-hover, speed, and gap settings.
